basic_info.description: 3148 Clay St is a stunning two-level condo on a picturesque, tree-lined block opposite a charming Carnegie libraryno neighbors directly across! The home blends classic Victorian allure with modern updates, including electrical, plumbing, and seismic reinforcements. Enter through a gated courtyard with intercom to find soaring 10-foot ceilings, herringbone hardwood floors, and original sliding doors that create flexible living and dining spaces. Abundant natural light pours into the south-facing living area, anchored by one of three wood-burning fireplaces. A convenient powder room serves the main levelideal for guests. The newly refreshed kitchen boasts high-end appliances, sleek stone countertops, solid wood cabinetry, and a handy dumbwaiter to the garage. Upstairs, two spacious ensuite bedrooms feature individually controlled heat, custom built-ins, generous closets, and additional fireplaces. Twelve skylights flood the top floor with sunlight, and each suite opens to a private deck. The primary suite offers a spa-inspired bath with new stone surfaces, matte black fixtures, and a beverage station. One garage parking space and shared storage meet practical needs. Enjoy an unbeatable location near shops, Alta Plaza Park, and the Presidio!
